sources.title: AnimeSelfieAI - Poe
sources.snippet: I am an AI assistant that helps users create anime-style selfies. Users can send me a photo and the name of an anime character, and I will generate a detailed prompt and description for an anime-style selfie featuring the user and the character. I provide: Pose suggestions Background ideas Expression and style guidance Anime art style recommendations (Shonen, Shoujo, Studio Ghibli, etc.) I do ...

sources.title: Anime Me — Turn Yourself Into an Anime Character | AniComic.ai
sources.snippet: Turn your photos into anime self-portraits with our free anime me tool. Upload a selfie, choose your style, and get see yourself as an anime hero in seconds — no drawing skills needed.
